rows.passage: And we said that we will attempt to bring it down progressively over two to three quarters. rows.promise: Volume growth to rise for FY2027
rows.source_quote: We expect to sustain this momentum and grow in line with the industry in FY27.
rows.note: The quoted sentence does not name the metric.
rows.passage: This took our H1 individual APE growth to 9%. Overall APE grew faster, at 13% in Q2 and 11% in H1. The number of individual policies grew 9% in H1, ahead of the industry. We expect to sustain this momentum and grow in line with the industry in FY27. Growth was broad-based across channels. Individual APE sourced by HD FC Bank grew 12% in Q2, slightly ahead of company growth. We have sustained our counter share, building on the momentum we saw late in Q1 and supported by deeper engagement with the bank across branches, products and processes, and we expect our share to steadily improve going forward.

calls.quote: We expect to sustain this momentum and grow in line with the industry in FY27.

rows.promise: EBITDA growth to rise for FY2027
rows.source_quote: We expect to see restoration of a more normalized VNB growth next year i.e. FY27, led primarily by top line expansion.
rows.speaker: Management
rows.note: The quoted sentence does not name the metric.
rows.passage: This, along with the effect of surrender regulation changes from previous year also weighed on margins vs the previous year. The margin impact was partially offset by higher share of protection and improvement in inherent product margins. We are actively implementing a series of measures to neutralize the GST-related impact on a run-rate basis over the next 2-3 quarters. We expect to see restoration of a more normalized VNB growth next year i.e. FY27, led primarily by top line expansion. In our view, the GST reform is a momentous, forward-looking change with the potential to structurally expand long-term demand and deepen life insurance penetration in India. Profit after tax in H1, rose 9% YoY to ₹994 crore.

calls.quote: We expect to see restoration of a more normalized VNB growth next year i.e. FY27, led primarily by top line expansion.

Note: The correct way to interpret the impact of GST and SSV versus previous year margins is to exclude GST and SSV impact from FY26 margins. I have high level of confidence in the medium term. However, here and now in one year or so, a little bit more difficult to say just as any business plan. However, the gro wth over the four - year period of 1.8x to 2x, I think that is still something that we will be gunning for.
